desc: Identify that the required overlap is the longest palindromic suffix of `S`, not the longest palindromic prefix.
Derive and implement KMP to find the longest palindromic suffix using `reverse(S) + separator + S`.
Construct the answer as `S + reverse(S[:-k])`, where `k` is the palindromic-suffix length.
Ensure the separator cannot match uppercase English letters and handle input length up to 500000.
Wrap the corrected algorithm in the requested Python stdin/stdout code delimiters and verify all samples.
